mentions.name: Honorfit Blocker
mentions.description: A mobile app that blocks your phone screen until you complete exercises such as pushups or situps. It works on the honor system instead of tracking you with a camera, aiming to turn screen addiction into getting fit. An iPhone version is coming soon.
mentions.problem: Screen addiction; users want to turn time spent on their phones into exercise and fitness.
mentions.source_excerpt: An app that blocks your screen until you do pushups/situps/etc. Works on the honor system instead of tracking you with a camera though. Turn your screen addiction into getting fit.
mentions.author: tnrich
